propositions: Rebar's schema-blind structured-output extraction returns the first parseable JSON object in a reply, allowing schema-valid quoted material (tool results, examples) to override the actual payload
The defect recurs across model swaps and provider changes (Bedrock cutover) because the root cause in tolerant_parse is not addressed, only individual instances are patched
Three coordinated thrusts must harden the prompted path, enable provider-native structured output where measured safe, and establish a reusable measurement harness to prevent future regressions
Schema-filtered candidate selection with last-valid-wins in parse_structured, atomic sentinel output channels, and opt-in replay artifacts eliminate the prompt-shared defect class
Provider-native output must be gated on measured thinking-compatibility per model, not blanket-forced, with exact capability rows populated only where live measurement passed
